# Commercial and IP Readiness Pack

Status: candidate
Date: 2026-06-03
Release lane: internal-admin
Backlog coverage: T017, T022, T056, T060, T064, T070, T135, T259

## Purpose

This pack closes a high-value set of commercial, IP, and sales-readiness rows
without touching runtime code. It creates a single source set for the first
enterprise pilot conversation: entity rationale, trade-secret handling, pilot
one-pager, pricing/packaging, vendor-risk packet, and pilot success plus
conversion mechanics.

## What Changed

- Creates a C Corp decision memo suitable for founder/legal review.
- Creates a one-page trade secret policy for corpus, patterns, prompts,
  customer overlays, demos, pricing, and non-public roadmap materials.
- Creates a pilot one-pager anchored on the current higher-value pilot offer.
- Creates a pricing and packaging memo that reflects the current workbook:
  `$300k` pilot, `$950k` target year-1 platform ACV, `$40k/month` Source add-on,
  tiered users, token caps, and founder time valued at `$425/hour` with a
  roughly `10%` contract-value contribution.
- Creates a vendor information package index for buyer/procurement/security
  reviews.
- Creates pilot success criteria and auto-conversion mechanics for SOW drafting.

## Known Gaps

- This pack does not file trademarks, submit 83(b), open banking, apply for a
  DUNS number, bind insurance, or complete legal review.
- Pricing remains founder-approved business posture; final customer pricing
  still belongs in an executed order form/SOW.
- Vendor package fields that require external evidence remain marked as
  pending in the referenced materials.
